log.text: Liftoff. Mars in the window: 30° right. Fuel for 62 s of burn.
Out of the dense air: altitude 36, speed 16 u/s.
Meteor M-8 in the window (44° right, 30% of Mars's light). The pilot held its course.
Target centred in the window (-4°). DNp20: right 0 Hz, left 0 Hz.
Meteor M-7 in the window (32° right, 4% of Mars's light). The pilot held its course.
Meteor M-5 in the window (3° right, 19% of Mars's light). The pilot turned toward its light: the target slid to 12° left.
Meteor M-1 in the window (33° right, 30% of Mars's light). The pilot turned toward its light: the target slid to 149° left.
Flight computer: flip, engines first. Altitude 166, closing 40 u/s. The pilot's lever is off for the manoeuvre.
Target held centred for 5.6 s without a break.
Flip complete, landing burn. The pilot now looks through the landing camera; its lever moves the rocket sideways.
The pad never came to the centre of the camera: closest 6° left.
Flight computer: altitude 20. Below this the sideways speed is limited in proportion to height; the direction stays the pilot's.
Touchdown: 1.5 u/s down, 0.5 u/s sideways, ground slope 0°, 3.0 u from the centre of the pad.

The legs' signal reached 2,522 leg mechanosensory neurons. In 0.5 s the ascending neurons (legs → brain) fired 15,883 spikes, against 0 before contact. Strongest in the brain: PEN_a(PEN1) (+1,799), PEN_b(PEN2) (+1,680), cells with no named type (+1,623).

cause: LANDED ON THE PAD, T+56.2. 1.5 u/s down — soft. The crew is fine.
